description: Agent Readiness: submit a payment or refund flow’s retry design as paths (operation, timeout, how long the provider can take, retry triggers, most retries, idempotency key and its scope, duplicate detection and its window, status check before retry). The signed report names every path where a retry can produce a second charge, refund or settlement, the paths protected by an idempotency key, a confirmation check or duplicate detection, and the smallest fix for each unprotected path. Design review of the supplied material; live order records are wever_duplicate-order-check. Verdict double_effect_possible, protection_unverified or retry_safe. POST /api/retry-safety-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

paths.description: Payment and refund paths that can retry.

confirms_before_retry.description: The status is checked by reference before a retry.

window.description: How long duplicates are caught, such as 24h.

scope.description: Created once per operation or per attempt.

upstream_completes_within.description: How long the provider can take, such as 30s.
